messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync: were scheduling analyst pre-briefs next Wed. Target embargo lift is 2026-03-24 10:00 PT. Need to confirm slots + quote wording.
Eli (PR): I'll hold calendar tentatively. Can we lock the embargo today? Legal needs final language by Tue EOD for fact-checks.
Priya (Comms): Legal flagged 'industry-leading' in the draft. Recommend neutral phrasing like 'measured throughput improvement compared to default configs'.
Jonas (Product): Good call. Updated benchmark summary: median token latency reduced 28% on Dedicated with our tuning. Avoid broad multipliers without workload context.
Maya (Marketing): Roger. @Jonas help me craft two short quote variants (technical + customer). @Zoe can we add an EU-friendly slot at 9:00am PT?
Zoe (Ops): 9:00am PT works if we confirm by 15:00 PT Mon. We only have one extra demo slot that morning.
Eli (PR): Who will package the fact-check materials? Analysts asked for raw numbers and test harness link.
Jonas (Product): I'll assemble the perf CSV + runbook. Top of package:
```
model: redwood-v1-finetuned
hardware: 8xA100
batching: dynamic
seq_len: 1024
dataset: benchmark-suite-v3
```
I'll anonymize traces and attach the CSV.
Priya (Comms): For quotes: two options please. Tech: clear, precise. Customer-facing: outcome-focused. Send both and legal will pick.
Maya (Marketing): Drafts incoming. Tech: "Our Dedicated config reduced median token latency by 28% on representative RL workloads." Customer: "Customers saw meaningful latency improvements along with reduced per-token costs."
Eli (PR): Add attribution: " Maya Leung, Head of Marketing, Redwood Inference". Also include a short one-line explainer for embargoed brief.
PressBot: Embargo reminder set  embargo lift 2026-03-24 10:00 PT, fact-check deadline 2026-03-23 17:00 PT.
Priya (Comms): Analyst Y asked for raw traces; we should provide an aggregated CSV and a privacy note: 'client traces anonymized per privacy policy'.
Jonas (Product): Affirmative. I'll redact hostnames and remove any client-specific identifiers.
Zoe (Ops): Note: if we move embargo later than Wed 10:00 PT we need 12 hours notice to adjust the media list and invites.
Maya (Marketing): One analyst asked for a live demo. Can we prepare an 8-10 minute script emphasizing latency and rollout controls?
Jonas (Product): I'll create a 10-step demo script and record a fallback video in case of infra hiccups.
Eli (PR): I'll draft the invites and include both quote variants + perf CSV link. Please deliver final assets by Tue EOD. :thumbsup:
Maya (Marketing): Will post final package here when ready. Thanks everyone!
